Hello!
I'd like to request a horizontal couple illustration that can be used as a PC wallpaper, or for phone background as a present.

The theme is spring, so I’d love a romantic atmosphere surrounded by hydrangeas (his favorite flower).
There doesn't need to be a kissing scene—I'm hoping for a composition full of smiles and laughter, as if they’re enjoying a date together. (Please refer to the mood board for visual inspiration!)
They can either look at each other or look toward the viewer—whichever you feel fits best!

🐺 Wolf (171 cm)
Tsundere personality, but completely sweet and soft when it comes to Bunny’s requests.
More on the handsome/pretty-boy side.
No “ahoge” (cowlick).
Please show his fangs when he smiles.
If you’d like, feel free to draw him with a wolf-cut hairstyle.

🐰 Bunny (162 cm)
Totally affectionate and always gazing at Wolf.
Loves smiling at Wolf more than anything.
Has a very cute and soft body shape.
